sources.title: Water supply, wastewater and water quality
sources.role: Planning Practice Guidance on water infrastructure and quality
sources.facts: Explains Water Environment Regulations, river-basin plans, infrastructure phasing, wastewater, water quality and planning conditions or obligations.
sources.guard: Strategic guidance does not prove site capacity, water-company commitment, permit, connection, water-body impact or mitigation acceptance.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline
sources.role: Current regulator publication record for WRMP guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 16 June 2026; water companies must prepare and maintain water resources management plans and review them annually.
sources.origin: Environment Agency, Natural Resources Wales and Ofwat / GOV.UK
sources.guard: A WRMP duty or publication does not prove a particular development has supply, connection, funding or environmental approval.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline - HTML
sources.role: Detailed 2026 WRMP29 process and timetable guidance
sources.facts: Updated 16 June 2026; includes pre-consultation, resource statements, draft plans, consultation, reconciliation and final-plan milestones through 2029.
sources.origin: Environment Agency, Natural Resources Wales and Ofwat / GOV.UK
sources.guard: Future timetable, options and reconciliation do not prove selected schemes, deliverability, planning consent or site-level availability.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline update
sources.role: Consultation outcome for updated WRMP guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 8 May 2026; confirms consultation feedback was considered and updated guidance was published.
sources.guard: Consultation outcome does not prove water-company plan approval, option selection, funding or parcel supply.

sources.title: Water resources planning guideline: consultation response summary
sources.role: Official summary of consultation changes and next steps
sources.facts: Updated 8 May 2026; records consultation method, changes, key topics and next steps.
sources.guard: Response summary is process evidence and does not establish technical feasibility, regulator acceptance or infrastructure delivery.

sources.title: Appendix 1: Changes to the Environmental Destination for Water Resources planning guidance
sources.facts: Updated 8 May 2026; explains post-consultation changes and key response topics for environmental-destination guidance.
sources.guard: Change record does not prove ecological outcome, water-body status, option selection or development acceptability.

sources.title: Nutrient mitigation: check if you need environmental permissions
sources.role: Environment Agency and Natural England permission-screening guidance
sources.facts: Explains that mitigation works may require environmental permissions and planning consultees may require supporting information.
sources.origin: Environment Agency and Natural England / GOV.UK
sources.guard: Screening guidance does not prove nutrient neutrality, permit need, permit grant, habitats compliance or planning approval.

sources.title: Using the nutrient neutrality calculators
sources.role: Current Natural England nutrient-budget calculator guidance
sources.facts: March 2026 updates changed River Camel and River Eden catchment treatment following WINEP boundary review.
sources.guard: Calculator output is proposal-input evidence and does not prove correct inputs, secured mitigation, permit compliance, habitats conclusion or decision.
